# خَنَنْتِ (ḵananti) /xa.nan.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of خَنَّ (ḵanna)
# خُنِنْتُ (ḵunintu) /xu.nin.tu/: first-person singular past passive of خَنَّ (ḵanna)
